dialogue.speaker: typhon
dialogue.text: I am Typhon, father of all monsters.

dialogue.speaker: typhon
dialogue.text: Tonight, the sea and shore burn.

dialogue.speaker: cthulhu
dialogue.text: I am Cthulhu, dreamer of R'lyeh.

dialogue.speaker: cthulhu
dialogue.text: You woke me from the deep.

dialogue.speaker: cthulhu
dialogue.text: Do not sail when the stars align.

sentences.speaker: typhon
sentences.text: I am Typhon, father of all monsters.

sentences.speaker: typhon
sentences.text: Even Olympus fled my fire.

sentences.speaker: typhon
sentences.text: Tonight, the sea and shore burn.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu
sentences.text: I am Cthulhu, dreamer of R'lyeh.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu
sentences.text: You woke me from the deep.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu
sentences.text: Now face the abyss.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: On a moonless night, a fishing fleet drifted near the rocky shore.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Suddenly the sea boiled, and Typhon rose in a firestorm.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yet the tremors woke Cthulhu, who rose to shield the boats.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The kid scrambled up the rocks to hide.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Typhon beat his black wings, hurling hurricanes across the waves.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then Cthulhu spread his narrow wings, flooding the sky with darkness.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Furious, Typhon tore volcanic rock from the seabed and hurled it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: So Cthulhu summoned R'lyeh, raising impossible stone from the abyss.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But Typhon unleashed a hundred-headed roar that cracked the stone.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His serpent coils crushed Cthulhu, blasting him into green mist.

sentences.speaker: typhon
sentences.text: Burn in my fire!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Meanwhile, a flaming tidal wave slammed the rocky shore.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yet Cthulhu was never flesh, so the mist reformed instantly.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then his psychic call pierced Typhon's hundred raging minds.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Trapped in the waves, Typhon fired his final firestorm.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu
sentences.text: Drown in madness.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: As R'lyeh's stone dragged him down, the deep sea quenched his flames.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At last, the storm broke over the safe shore.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu
sentences.text: Go home, little one.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu
sentences.text: Do not sail when the stars align.

sentences.speaker: kid
sentences.text: ...Are you staying?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: By midnight, the boats floated on glassy water.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Until the stars above slowly shifted into line.

sentences.speaker: cthulhu_whisper
sentences.text: The stars are almost right.
